# Termux terminal libraries

Source files in `terminal-emulator` and `terminal-view` are derived from the
Termux `terminal-emulator` and `terminal-view` modules at
https://github.com/termux/termux-app (revision 8629e632fcb95da272221be327db653fb24befe9).
Those modules use the Android Terminal Emulator code licensed under Apache-2.0;
see `LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt` and the upstream license exceptions in `LICENSE.md`.
The Gradle build files were adapted for Codux. Source copyright and upstream notices
are retained with the source tree. The full Termux application is GPLv3-only; no
GPL-only Termux app module has been copied into this directory.
